## Terms

### Point of No Return

- **Point of No Return** · self — The practical point of no return is a change in rollback feasibility, not simply the restart onto newer binaries. Raising featureCompatibilityVersion (FCV) enables features that persist data incompatible with the older release; MongoDB recommends a burn-in period before enabling them.
